test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) by adopting modern methods

(B) farmers can increase

(C) agricultural production

(D) effectively
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **BCAD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence starts with the subject, which is the action "farmers can increase," indicated by **part (B).**
 
• Following this, "agricultural production" **(C)** logically completes what farmers can increase.
 
• The next part, "by adopting modern methods" **(A),** explains how farmers can achieve this increase.
 
• Finally, "effectively" **(D)** concludes the sentence, emphasizing the manner of achieving the increase.

Therefore, the correct sequence is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (****ABCD****):** This sequence is incorrect as it disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (BADC):** This option places "effectively" prematurely, creating a grammatically incorrect sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This option disrupts the logical order of "by adopting modern methods," placing it after "effectively."
